notes.title: The Perished | Official Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
With my game's release soon on the horizon, I'd like to share this awesome new trailer with the community. Check it out!

[previewyoutube=u3IS4uTrq6w;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Over the past few months, I have been putting in blood, sweat, and tears to finish my game and make it as fun and frightening as possible! This trailer shows off some of the new content in the game and will show you what to expect from this experience.

Wishlist now so you can play on launch day!
